story.so_that: automated refinement never mutates the wrong repository or overwrites unrelated work
story.i_want: the workflow to resolve exactly one target Git worktree and validate all safety preconditions before refinement begins

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a repository anchor path and no explicit target repository root, when preflight runs, then the workflow resolves the nearest containing Git worktree root and records its canonical path and starting revision
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a repository anchor path and no explicit target repository root when preflight runs then the workflow resolves the nearest containing Git worktree root and records its canonical path and starting revision

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given both an anchor-derived root and an explicit root are supplied and they identify different Git worktrees, when preflight runs, then the request is rejected before any agent is invoked
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given an anchor-derived root and an explicit root that identify different Git worktrees when preflight runs then the workflow rejects the request before invoking an agent

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a scoped input, skill, evaluation, or authorized-scope path resolves outside the target worktree, when preflight validates it, then the request is rejected
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a scoped input, skill, evaluation, or authorized-scope path resolves outside the target worktree when preflight validates it then the workflow rejects the request

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the target worktree has staged, unstaged, or untracked changes, when preflight inspects repository status, then the workflow rejects the request and leaves the worktree unchanged
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the target worktree has staged, unstaged, or untracked changes when preflight inspects repository status then the workflow rejects the request and leaves the worktree unchanged

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given another workflow run already holds the mutation lease for the same target repository, when preflight runs, then the workflow rejects or waits according to configured policy without starting refinement
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given another workflow run already holds the mutation lease for the same target repository when preflight runs then the workflow rejects or waits according to configured policy without starting refinement

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the target skill does not exist, or exists but has no evaluation suite, in the target repository, when preflight runs, then the workflow rejects the request before refinement begins
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the target skill does not exist or exists without an evaluation suite in the target repository when preflight runs then the workflow rejects the request before refinement begins

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given required test cases, a deterministic evaluation command, a single execution provider, and iteration or token limits are all supplied and valid, when preflight runs, then preflight succeeds, acquires the repository mutation lease, and reports no other side effects
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given required test cases, a deterministic evaluation command, a single execution provider, and valid iteration and token limits when preflight runs then preflight succeeds, acquires the repository mutation lease, and reports no other side effects

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given any precondition fails, when preflight completes, then the workflow reports every failed condition and releases any lease it had acquired
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given any precondition fails when preflight completes then the workflow reports every failed condition and releases any lease it had acquired

edge_cases.criterion: Both repository anchor and explicit target root are missing or empty
edge_cases.gherkin: Given both repository anchor and explicit target root are missing when preflight runs then the workflow rejects the request with a clear validation error

edge_cases.criterion: Anchor path is not inside any Git worktree
edge_cases.gherkin: Given an anchor path outside any Git worktree when preflight runs then the workflow rejects the request and reports that no repository could be resolved

edge_cases.criterion: Anchor and explicit root resolve to the same worktree through different path forms
edge_cases.gherkin: Given an anchor and explicit root are represented by different relative, absolute, or symlinked paths that resolve to the same worktree when preflight runs then the workflow accepts the resolved target

edge_cases.criterion: Scoped path contains parent-directory traversal that escapes the target worktree
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a scoped path contains '..' or symlink traversal that resolves outside the target worktree when preflight validates it then the workflow rejects the request

edge_cases.criterion: Target worktree is a nested Git repository inside another worktree
edge_cases.gherkin: Given an anchor path is inside a nested Git repository when preflight runs then the workflow resolves the innermost containing worktree as the target

edge_cases.criterion: Target worktree is dirty because of preflight-created files in a known scratch directory
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the only changes in the target worktree are in a configured scratch or process directory when preflight inspects status then the workflow ignores those changes and does not reject on that basis

edge_cases.criterion: Current workflow already holds the mutation lease for the target repository
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the current workflow run already holds a mutation lease for the same target repository when preflight runs then the workflow treats it as already acquired rather than rejecting

edge_cases.criterion: Lease store is temporarily unavailable during preflight
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the mutation lease store is unavailable when preflight attempts to acquire the lease then the workflow reports the lease failure without invoking an agent or mutating the worktree

edge_cases.criterion: Git executable is absent or returns a non-zero exit code
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the Git executable is missing or fails when preflight queries repository status or revision then the workflow reports a git failure and rejects the request

edge_cases.criterion: Target worktree is on a read-only or full filesystem
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the target worktree is on a read-only or full filesystem when preflight validates it then the workflow reports the filesystem condition and rejects the request

steps.description: Implement TargetWorktreeResolver: resolve the nearest Git worktree from an anchor or explicit root, canonicalize both with realpath, and reject missing or conflicting roots
Implement ScopedPathValidator: canonicalize scoped inputs with Path.resolve(), enforce containment via relative_to, and reject traversal or symlink escapes
Implement RepositoryStatusInspector: call git status, classify changes, allow configured scratch globs when all unexpected changes are confined, and reject otherwise
Implement SkillAndEvaluationDiscovery: verify the target skill directory and evaluation suite exist without parsing semantic content
Implement MutationLeaseStore: persist leases keyed by repo_key and run_id with TTL, acquire, release, and is_held operations, and conflict detection
Implement MutationLeasePolicyHandler: apply immediate-reject policy, detect re-entrant same-run leases, and wrap acquisition in explicit release on terminal paths
Implement resolve_and_validate_target_repository activity: sequence the checks, emit instrumentation events, and return a PreflightResult with TargetRepositoryContext
Update EDD workflow to call preflight and gate downstream refinement activities on a success status, passing TargetRepositoryContext to each
Update SkillActivityInput/SkillActivityOutput to accept an optional TargetRepositoryContext and use it instead of an implicit REPO_ROOT
Render the preflight success/failure report in the UI and adapt the request form based on caller role
Instrument and emit ResolveTargetRepository, ValidateScopedPaths, CheckRepositoryStatus, AcquireMutationLease, ReleaseMutationLease, and CompletePreflight events

unit_tests.description: TargetWorktreeResolver handles missing anchor, nested repo, and equivalent paths through symlinks/relative forms
ScopedPathValidator rejects parent traversal, symlink escapes, and paths outside the resolved worktree
RepositoryStatusInspector correctly flags dirty, scratch-only, and clean worktrees
SkillAndEvaluationDiscovery returns true only when skill directory and evaluation suite are present
MutationLeaseStore enforces uniqueness by repo_key/run_id, respects TTL, and handles re-entrant same-run requests

integration_tests.description: Full preflight activity sequence against a real Git worktree with dirty, nested, and conflict scenarios
Lease store acquire/release with concurrent runs and simulated store unavailability
Workflow gating: EDD-002/003/004 only run after successful preflight and receive TargetRepositoryContext

e2e_tests.description: Requester submits preflight and receives either a validated, clean, leased target repository or a complete list of failed conditions

risks_and_mitigations.risk: A path-traversal or symlink attack could make a scoped input resolve outside the target worktree
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Canonicalize with Path.resolve() and enforce containment with Path.relative_to before any skill runs

risks_and_mitigations.risk: A crash after lease acquisition leaves the repository locked indefinitely
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Use a short TTL and an explicit release in a try/finally block; acquire only after all other checks pass

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Git command failures or missing git executable cause opaque workflow errors
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Wrap git calls, capture exit codes and stderr, and surface a clear PreflightFailureReport

risks_and_mitigations.risk: A dirty worktree from an unrelated in-flight edit is mutated by refinement
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Reject any worktree with unexpected staged/unstaged/untracked changes and confine scratch exceptions to configured globs

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Concurrent runs targeting the same repository race and corrupt each other's changes
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Immediate-reject policy on lease conflict; store keyed by canonical repo_key and run_id
